moments.author: Cat Wu
moments.quote: Some news: I’m joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products!
moments.why: High-impact AI industry move—product lead jumping from Anthropic to OpenAI amid IPO buzz; thousands liked and replied fast, signaling major chatter among tech-savvy men.

moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Trade: The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett … deal expected to be completed this weekend.
moments.why: Major NFL quarterback shuffle—Ravens scrambling to stabilize season after injuries, instantly sparking massive debate among sports fans.

moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: Ram Altman: “People shouldn’t cede control of the future to superintelligence…”
moments.why: Sam Altman’s tongue-in-cheek rename (‘Ram Altman’) combined with AI culture panic vibe created a wave among tech audiences.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: “The people deserve to have their RAM too!” mocking Altman’s RAM stance.
moments.why: Musk’s reply to Altman’s RAM comments escalated into a viral AI-hardware debate, trending hard with men into tech and memes.
